scenarios.title: redshift examples synchronize both views, travel time and cosmic ages while preserving other simulations
keyboard and native rate controls keep fixed matter assumptions and published input labels accurate
touch chart selection and pointer cancellation leave controls editable and focus intact
published spectrum redshift imports its provenance and survives restore until the distance setting changes
phone contrast keeps glyphs readable, axis labels separated, shared scales accurate and targets usable
damaged persisted values recover to finite linked views and retain valid notes
teaching presets preserve the physical wavelength ratios and accessible values
measured galaxy examples preserve precision and distinguish measurements from modeled lines
keyboard changes, bounds and section navigation keep the current comparison coherent
320px contrast layout keeps measured values, controls and chart within the viewport

scientificInputs.study: Schouws et al. 2025 / imported JADES-GS-z14-0 reference
Hogg / distance measures and lookback definitions
Riess et al. 2024 / JWST Cepheid crowding test

model.independentValidation: Fixed-grid Simpson integration with 16,000 intervals for distance, lookback time and age using a different integration variable for age
model.plottedDistances: Present comoving separation, proper separation at emission and c times lookback time on a fixed 0–50 Gly linear scale
limitations: Radiation and detailed neutrino evolution omitted
No peculiar velocities or gravitational redshift
No recombination, CMB or inflation simulation
Published uncertainties displayed but not propagated
SH0ES comparison changes H0 only; matter fraction stays fixed
Named historical inputs, not a live estimate
Galaxy symbols have fixed illustrative sizes; rows are epoch snapshots, not photon trajectories

behavior: Slider, chart, epoch positions and physical readouts share one redshift
Touch, keyboard, pointer cancellation and saved-state recovery verified
Published redshift source labels persist only for matching values
Spectrum handoff transfers redshift and provenance, scrolls and focuses distance section
Other simulation state and investigation notes preserved
No new playback clock or network request added
corrections: Hubble-tension copy now limits JWST conclusions to tested crowding and photometry effects
initialRunRecovery: Initial unit run passed 141 of 142. Corrected an assertion to exercise the SH0ES comparison branch; final clean run passed 142 with exit code 0. Initial run also reported a fork teardown timeout.
